R='/project1/glsl_test_8'
import json
results={}
results['container']=R
children=[]
for c in op(R).children:
    info={'name':c.name,'type':str(type(c)).split('.')[-1].rstrip('>')+'''}
    if 'glslPOP' in str(type(c)):
        info['errors']=str(c.errors())
        info['outputattrs']=str(c.par.outputattrs.eval())
        info['numelems']=c.par.numelems.eval()
        info['numinputs']=len(c.inputConnectors)
        info['computedat']=str(c.par.computedat.eval())
    children.append(info)
results['children']=children
results['total']=len(children)
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
